text: {"lessons":["My account rose for two periods, then fell for two; short-term gains and losses are part of investing, and recent moves do not predict what comes next.","Losses bother me more than equal gains please me, so I should recognize that bias without letting it drive impulsive decisions.","I rarely trade and made no trades so far; I should review my holdings calmly and make deliberate choices rather than trade just because prices changed."]}
